user.title: waipu.tv login
user.description: Username and password of your waipu.tv account. Two-factor authentication is not supported.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed — please verify your credentials.

init.title: waipu.tv options
init.description: Choose which channels become HA entities and optionally configure the Apple TV and/or Android TV link. Note: if 'Channel number basis' is set to 'Favorites only', 'Visible channels' is ignored — HA entities then follow your waipu favorites live.

data.waipu_bundle_id: waipu app bundle id on tvOS
data.waipu_app_link: waipu app link on Android TV (deep link recommended)
data.android_tv_channel_view: Channel number basis (must match the channel view shown in the waipu app)

delete_recording.name: Delete recording
delete_recording.description: Delete one or more cloud recordings.

launch_on_apple_tv.name: Launch waipu on Apple TV
launch_on_apple_tv.description: Open the waipu app on the configured Apple TV.

launch_on_android_tv.name: Launch waipu on Android TV
launch_on_android_tv.description: Open the waipu app on the configured Android TV.

switch_channel_on_android_tv.name: Switch channel on Android TV (experimental)
switch_channel_on_android_tv.description: Switches channel via number-key presses — must match the waipu app's current channel view.
